page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block from top to bottom, with a woodcut emblem in the centre below the text and the imprint beneath it. Handwriting in the right margin and at the foot is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.l: C L A V I S
In quo præter textus Analysin, Axiomata Ethica-
tiuntur, exemplisque & usu ad præsentis seculi
M D C X I V.

page.notes: Woodcut emblem of a column with flames and clouds, with the inscription DEO ... around it, between the Sive line and the imprint; not transcribed. Manuscript annotations in the right margin ("1 C Hewe..." / "1 6 31") and at the foot are handwriting and are omitted. The Greek line is transcribed as best read; the accents are uncertain. The "5C" mark at upper right is a handwritten shelf or pencil mark and is omitted.
